slides.title: JaeBee, QCS or XC Flex Weapon?
slides.sub: Three StayBent blades, three different personalities on the ice

slides.title: JaeBee is built for feel
slides.body: The most flexible blade in the StayBent range. A tapered tube gives progressive flex, so the tips give more than the middle through a technical corner.

slides.title: QCS stays planted
slides.body: Built on the same tube as the Quantum, with even stiffness along the full length. Many developing racers find that easier to trust.

slides.title: XC Flex Weapon is the flagship
slides.body: Precision built in the Netherlands for extra grip through the corner, with Precise Bend Technology for accurate, repeatable bend radiuses.

slides.title: Your boot length may decide it
slides.body: Only the JaeBee reaches down to 14.5. The QCS starts at 15. The XC Flex Weapon starts at 16.5 but is the only one in quarter steps.

slides.title: Lengths side by side
slides.caption: The JaeBee starts lowest, the XC Flex Weapon runs in quarter steps.

slides.title: Bimetal or full PM steel
slides.body: Bimetal is easier to sharpen and forgiving day to day. Full PM holds an edge longer for skaters who train most days.
